title: The Education (School Day and School Year) (Wales) (Amendment) Regulations 2026 / Rheoliadau Addysg (Y Diwrnod Ysgol a’r Flwyddyn Ysgol) (Cymru) (Diwygio) 2026
summary: The Education (School Day and School Year) (Wales) Regulations 2003 (“the 2003 Regulations”) make provision about the length of the school day and school year. The 2003 Regulations provide that the school day is ordinarily divided into two sessions with a break in the middle, and for schools to meet for at least 380 sessions during any school year.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Doncaster, South Yorkshire) Regulations 2026
The Provision of Health Services to Persons Not Ordinarily Resident (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Provision of Health Services to Persons Not Ordinarily Resident Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2015 (“the 2015 Regulations”) which make available, to visitors in Northern Ireland, certain health services under the Health and Personal Social Services (Northern Ireland) Order 1972, at a charge determined by the Department of Health. The 2015 Regulations also provide for various exemptions from charges: some services are always exempt from charge, while some categories of visitor are exempt from charge.

title: The Public Health (Notifiable Diseases – Hantavirus Diseases) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: This Order extends the list of notifiable diseases specified by the Public Health Act (Northern Ireland) 1967 to include Hantavirus diseases, including hantavirus pulmonary/cardiopulmonary syndrome (HCPS) and haemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS).

title: The Green Road, Conlig (Abandonment) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026
The Prison (Governor’s and Adjudicators’ Punishments) (Amendment) Rules 2026
summary: These Rules amend the Prison Rules 1999 (S.I. 1999/728) by extending the punishments available to a governor and to an adjudicator following a finding of guilt for an offence against discipline listed in Prison Rule 51.

title: The Police (Conduct and Vetting etc.) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations principally amend the Police (Conduct) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/4) (“the Conduct Regulations”) and the Police (Vetting) Regulations 2025 (S.I. 2025/502) (“the Vetting Regulations”). They also make consequential and subsidiary amendments to the Police (Complaints and Misconduct) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/2) (“the Complaints and Misconduct Regulations”), the Police Regulations 2003 (S.I. 2003/527) (“the Police Regulations”) and the Police (Performance) Regulations 2020 (S.I. 2020/3) (“the Performance Regulations”).

title: The Pension Schemes Act 2026 (Commencement No. 1) Regulations 2026
summary: These are the first commencement regulations made under the Pension Schemes Act 2026 (c. 22) (“the Act”).

title: The Sunnica Energy Farm (Amendment) Order 2026
summary: This Order amends the Sunnica Energy Farm Order 2024, a development consent order under the Planning Act 2008, following an application made in accordance with the Infrastructure Planning (Changes to, and Revocation of, Development Consent Orders) Regulations 2011 for a non-material amendment under paragraph 2 of Schedule 6 to the Planning Act 2008. This Order amends Schedule 10 of the 2024 Order relating to certified documents.

title: The Roads (Speed Limit) (No. 2) Order (Northern Ireland) 2026
The Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) (Amendment No. 2) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations amend regulation 5 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1996 (“1996 Regulations”) to permit the driving of zero-emission vehicles in certain circumstances in excess of the maximum authorised mass that would otherwise apply.

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Sywell) Regulations 2026
The Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) (Amendment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 1996 to allow holders of Group 2 licences (bus and lorry drivers) who have diabetes to use any appropriate glucose monitoring system to monitor their glucose levels instead of blood glucose testing.

title: The Wireless Telegraphy (Direct to Device Satellite Communications) (Exemption) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Wireless Telegraphy (Direct to Device Satellite Communications) (Exemption) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/139) (“the Principal Regulations”) to extend the circumstances in which wireless telegraphy apparatus (including mobile phones) which are established, installed or used for direct to device services will be exempt from the requirement to be licensed under section 8(1) of the Wireless Telegraphy Act 2006 (c. 36).

title: The Air Navigation (Restriction of Flying) (Birkdale, Merseyside) Regulations 2026
Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations amend the National Health Service (General Dental Services Contracts) Regulations 2005 (S.I. 2005/3361) (“the GDS Contracts Regulations”), the National Health Service (Personal Dental Services Agreements) Regulations 2005 (S.I. 2005/3373) (“the PDS Agreements Regulations”) and the National Health Service (Dental Charges) Regulations 2005 (S.I. 2005/3477) (“the NHS Charges Regulations”).

title: Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations bring into force specified provisions in the Digital Economy Act 2017 (“the 2017 Act”) and the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 (“the 2025 Act”).

title: Correction Slip
summary: These Regulations amend the Environmental Authorisations (Scotland) Regulations 2018 (the “2018 Regulations”) to bring water, waste and industrial emissions activities into the framework for authorisation of environmental activities provided by the 2018 Regulations, which currently only apply to radioactive substances activities in Scotland.
